Class BoundCommand

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.swing.ui.BoundCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
DynamicEntry, MenuEntry, ToolBarEntry
public final class BoundCommand extends Object implements MenuEntry, DynamicEntry, ToolBarEntry
A command of a view, turned into Swing objects. Each created component shares the command's Action, so text, icon, tooltip, enabled and selected state stay in sync.
